description: [Paid-only, $0.10 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/new-parent-benefits with x402.] Everything a South Korean household receives around a birth, in one call: maternity leave pay (90/120 days, who pays what), parental leave benefit month by month (normal, 6+6 both-parents, or single-parent scheme), the spouse's 20-day childbirth leave pay, and government cash support for the child (first-meeting voucher, parent benefit, child allowance to age 9).

area.description: Residence area for the child allowance amount; default capital

daycare.description: Child attends daycare (parent benefit replaced by the daycare subsidy); default false

firstChild.description: First child (voucher KRW 2,000,000; later children 3,000,000); default true

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage of the parent taking maternity leave (KRW)

multipleBirth.description: Twins or more (120 days); default false

parentalLeaveMode.description: normal (default), both_parents (6+6 scheme; needs the spouse fields) or single_parent

parentalLeaveMonths.description: Months of parental leave after maternity leave; default 12, 0 for none

priorityCompany.description: Employer is a priority-support (SME) company; default true

spouseMonthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Spouse's monthly ordinary wage; adds the spouse's childbirth leave pay (KRW)

spouseParentalLeaveMonths.description: Months of parental leave the spouse takes; default 0

spousePriorityCompany.description: Spouse's employer is a priority-support company; default true

name: new_parent_benefits
